name: OpenVibe.Services
description: OpenVibe.Services will be the way into everything programmable on OpenVibe. Start from what you want to build (monitor a page and summarise changes, run an AI agent, process uploads, control a robot, add support to a site) and it assembles the services, keys, permissions and working code for you. Then operate it all in one place: projects, grants, usage, quotas, runs, events, deploys and health, with each service keeping its own data.

pillars.title: Discover
pillars.text: A catalog of services, recipes and templates, by what they do.

pillars.title: Build
pillars.text: Projects, apps, keys, capabilities, playgrounds and starter code.

pillars.title: Operate
pillars.text: Every resource across the network: runs, events, usage, quotas, health.

pillars.title: Learn
pillars.text: Help, Wiki and Codes docs, linked from every page.
